original: 母さんのチーズスープ……。\n久しぶりに食べたいなぁ
traducao: Mom's cheese soup......\nI'd love to eat it after so long.

original: ふん……、ホームシックか？
traducao: Hmph...... Homesick, are you?

original: そ、そんなんじゃ……
traducao: N-No, it's not like that......

original: ただ、僕が家に帰ってきた時に\nいつも母さんが、あったかいチーズスープを\n作って待っててくれたんだ
traducao: It's just, whenever I came home,\nMom always made warm cheese soup\nand waited for me.

original: それを思い出して……母さん、今も\n僕の帰りを待って、チーズスープを\n作ってくれているのかなって……
traducao: Remembering that... I wondered if Mom\nis still waiting for my return,\nmaking cheese soup even now......

original: それがホームシックだというんだ
traducao: That's the definition of homesick.

original: 結局、親が恋しくなったって\nだけなんだろうが？
traducao: In the end, it just means\nyou miss your parents, doesn't it?

original: うう……
traducao: Ugh...

original: そ、そう……なの、かな
贅沢なもんだ。\nホームシックになれる居場所が\n普通にあるというのはな
traducao: Must be nice.\nHaving a home you can naturally feel\nhomesick for like that.

original: せいぜい、両親を大事にしてやれ
traducao: Cherish your parents as best you can.

original: 孝行出来る親がいるというのは\n悪い事じゃない
traducao: Having parents you can show devotion to\nisn't a bad thing.

original: アッシュ……？
あ、あのさ、イリア……！
traducao: U-Um, hey, Iria......!

original: ちょっと、いいかな？
traducao: Do you have a moment?

original: えっ？
traducao: Eh?

original: なっ、何よ。\n急に改まっちゃって……
traducao: Wh-What is it?\nGetting all formal out of nowhere......

original: その、今度……\nぼ、僕と……一緒に……！
traducao: Um, sometime soon......\nW-With me...... together......!

original: おーす、二人とも！\n元気にしてるかあ？
traducao: Yo, you two!\nHow're you doing?!

original: って、アンタ\nどっから沸いて出たのよっ！
traducao: Where on earth\ndid you just pop out from?!

original: な、何だよ、怒るなよ。\nちょっと挨拶しただけじゃんかよ〜
traducao: Wh-What, don't get mad!\nI was just saying hi~

original: （うう、いい雰囲気だったのに……）
traducao: (Ugh, the mood was so good too......)

original: ルカ、また勉強してるのか？\n随分頑張ってるよなぁ
traducao: Studying again, Ruca?\nYou really work so hard.

original: うん……。\nでも、医者になるには、もっともっと\n勉強しておかないと
traducao: Yeah......\nStill, to become a doctor, I need\nto study much, much more.

original: 人の命を預かる仕事だからね……
traducao: It's a job with lives in your hands...

original: そっか。\nルカは医者になりたいんだったな
traducao: Right.\nYou want to be a doctor, Ruca.

original: すげえよな。\nオレなんて、将来自分が何になりたいかなんて\nまだ全然わからないよ
traducao: That's amazing.\nI have no idea what I want to become\nin the future at all.

original: そんなもん、オレだってわかんねえよ
traducao: Shoot, I don't know that either.

original: まぁ、毎日美味いもん食べて\nたっぷり寝て過ごせたら、\n何も言う事ねえんだけどな
traducao: Well, if I eat good food and sleep\nplenty every day, then I have\nnothing else to ask for.

original: リッドはそればっかだな
traducao: That's all you ever care about, Reid.

original: でも、リッドらしいよ
traducao: Still, it's very like you, Reid.

original: 僕だって、本当に医者に\nなれるかどうかもわからないし\nこの先どうなるかだって……
traducao: I don't even know if I can truly\nbecome a doctor, or what's ahead,\nin the future either......

original: だけど、後で振り返って\nやらなかった事を後悔するのは\n違うかなって思うから……
traducao: Still, looking back and regretting\nwhat I didn't do feels wrong,\nso I want to try......

original: そうだな。　\nやらねえ後悔より\nやった後悔のがなんぼかマシだ
traducao: Yeah.\nRegretting what you did is far better\nthan regretting what you didn't.

original: オレも何かやってみようかな
traducao: Maybe I should try something too.

original: また三日坊主で\n終わんなきゃいいけどな
traducao: Just hope you don't give it up\nafter three days again.

original: こ、子ども扱いするなよな！
traducao: D-Don't treat me like a kid!

original: あー。\n何か久しぶりに語っちゃって、\n肩が凝ったわ〜
traducao: Aah.\nTalking deeply for once after so long\ngave me stiff shoulders~

original: あ……、良かったら\n僕が揉んであげようか？
traducao: Ah... If you'd like,\nshall I give you a massage?

original: え？
traducao: Huh?

original: え？
traducao: Huh?

original: ……あ、ご、ごめんなさい！\n決して変な意味とかじゃなくって……
traducao: ......Ah, I-I'm so sorry!\nI didn't mean anything weird by it...

original: イリアにいつもやらされてるから\nつい……！
traducao: Iria always makes me do it,\nso it just slipped out...!

original: いや、別にいいんだけど。\nっていうか、むしろ\nありがたい申し出なんだけど
traducao: No, I don't mind at all.\nIn fact, it's quite a welcome offer,\nactually.

original: ……ルカってほんと\nイリアによく仕込まれてるのねぇ〜
traducao: ......You've really been thoroughly\ntrained by Iria, haven't you, Ruca~

original: そんな事で感心されても、\n嬉しくない……
traducao: Being praised for that\ndoesn't make me happy at all......

original: ルカの剣って大きいね〜。\nいつもそんなの持ち歩いていて\n疲れたりしないの？
traducao: Your sword is huge, Ruca~\nDoesn't carrying that around all day\ntire you out?

original: え？　\nそ、そうだね……。\nもう、慣れちゃった……かな
traducao: Eh?\nW-Well......\nI guess... I've gotten used to it.

original: 日頃の鍛錬の成果というやつか
traducao: The fruit of your daily training, eh?

original: 俺は、剣を使わないからわからないが……。\nやっぱり、そうなるまでには\n相当な苦労をしたんじゃないか？
traducao: I don't use swords, so I wouldn't know...\nStill, didn't you endure immense effort\nto reach that point?

original: 苦労……？
traducao: Hardship......?

original: （やけにツッコまれるなぁ……）
traducao: (They're really pressing me on this...)

original: う〜ん……。\n確かに、手にマメは\nよく出来たりしたけど……
traducao: Hmm......\nI did get blisters on my hands often,\nI suppose, but......

original: 剣が大きいから、重さで\n肩が凝ったりもしそうだよね
traducao: With a sword that big, the weight\nmust give you stiff shoulders!

original: ルカって実は、陰で\nすっごく努力をしてるんだね！
traducao: You must work incredibly hard\nbehind the scenes, Ruca!

original: ちょ、ちょっと待ってよ。\n大剣なら、ヴェイグだって使ってるよ？
traducao: H-Hold on a second.\nVeigue uses a greatsword too, you know?

original: なのに、僕だけ特別扱いみたいなのって\nおかしいっていうか……
traducao: So singling only me out for this\nfeels kind of strange...

original: それは……やっぱり
traducao: Well...... you see,

original: 見た目的に……な？
traducao: in terms of appearance...... right?

original: それって、\n遠回しに僕の体が\n貧相だって言ってる……？
traducao: Are you saying,\nin a roundabout way, that my build\nis completely scrawny......?

original: ルカ！\n今、ちょっと……いいかな？
traducao: Ruca!\nDo you have a moment right now?

original: ……？\nどうしたの、二人とも？
traducao: ......?\nWhat's the matter, you two?

original: その……この間は、悪かったな
traducao: Listen...... Sorry about the other day.

original: 見た目でお前を判断してるみたいな\n言い方をして……
traducao: Talking like we were judging you\nbased on your appearance......

original: そういうつもりじゃなかったんだ。\nほんとに……ただ、すごいなって……
traducao: We didn't mean it that way.\nReally... We just thought it was great...

original: ……うん。\nわかってるよ
traducao: ......Yeah.\nI understand.

original: それに、もういいんだ。\n大事な事を……思い出せたから
traducao: Besides, it's fine now.\nI remembered something important.

original: 大事な事？
traducao: Something important?

original: うん。\nこの剣は……みんなを守る為の力だから
traducao: Yeah.\nThis sword is power to protect everyone.

original: だから、似合わなくてもいいんだ。\n僕は……
traducao: So it doesn't matter if it suits me.\nI......

original: 似合わないなんて事ない！
traducao: It definitely suits you!

original: ああ。\n戦ってる時のお前は\n本当に堂々としている
traducao: Yeah.\nWhen you're fighting,\nyou truly look commanding.

original: カイル、セネル……
traducao: Kyle, Senel......

original: だから、ごめん……ルカ
traducao: So, I'm sorry...... Ruca.

original: 俺達の言い方が、悪かった……よな
traducao: We put it poorly... didn't we?

original: ……ううん、そんな事ないよ。\nもう……二人の気持ちもわかったし……
traducao: ......No, not at all.\nI understand how you both feel now......

original: ……大丈夫、だから……
traducao: ......So... it's alright......

original: えへへ……
traducao: Ehehe......

traducao: Normal.\n
